label: Nonlinear-fiber output (SPM)
tooltip: Er-fiber fs laser launched through 2 cm of highly-nonlinear fiber (OFS/Lightera HNLF, gamma = 11.5 W^-1km^-1): the source-side SPM transform (spm property) installs the exact multi-peak self-phase-modulated spectrum (phi_max ~ 9.5 rad here) and the S-curve chirp. Edit the spm property ('gamma:<W^-1km^-1>:length:<m>' or 'phimax:<rad>') to change the broadening.
